registered_before: the scoped threshold values; after the per-class and per-task residuals of the registered estimator were seen (declared post hoc scope decision)

why.scope: the E criterion targets industrial and service tasks; running and non-standing yoga poses are out of scope (user decision)
why.findings: contact-frame residual above 5% BW: treadmill running 41% (Hammer2013, the only running source), warrior I 22% and 43% (2 trials), overground walking, jumping, standing, squatting and the other whole-body tasks 0-3%; in all of them the residual vanishes when the moment rows of the GRF fit are dropped and is unchanged with friction 2.0 or without the vertical moment; the pipeline is invariant to a constant belt velocity (stance foot speed within +-5% of belt speed, belt slope <= 1.8 deg), so the treadmill does not explain it; cause in running not identified

scope.kept_by_default: ballet tasks (balletsmalljump, ballethighleg, ballet_high_leg); a variant without them is reported
scope.consequence: E results on generated running or yoga-like motions are not interpreted against the human threshold

estimator: registered contact rule (height only); amendment 1 failed and is not used

gate.checks: registered checks without the run class: walk V1 r >= 0.9, walk V1 RMSE <= 0.15 BW, walk and jump V3 >= 0.85
gate.status: walk V3 fails (0.77); the use of E for X4 is decided separately

threshold.rule: amendment 1 threshold rule (exclusions, tau_contact, tau_flight, tau_run) on the registered estimator (kin30), after the scope exclusions

reported: share of kept human frames above each tau
